name: Entice
text: Range: 12. Damage: 1d12 (ignoring armor). Target moves Primary Die spaces closer to you and gains 1d12 on their next attack.
highLevels: You may add 1d12 to both every 5th level.

name: Withering Touch
text: Reach: 1. Damage: 1d12. On damage, target is considered undead for 1 round.

name: Shadow Trap
restriction: Reaction: When an enemy moves next to an ally within Reach 8.
text: Reaction: When an enemy moves next to an ally within Reach 8. Damage: 2d12. If Small/Tiny, the enemy is also Restrained until they escape.
upcast: +1 size category and +1d12 damage on escape.

source.note: No Reach:/Range: field is printed; the trigger names Reach 8.

name: Dread Visage
text: Castable only while Defending. Damage: 1d12 and Frighten all creatures attacking you in melee this round. Costs 2 mana less while Dying.

name: Vampiric Greed
text: Reach: 1, AoE. Damage: 4d12. Heal HP equal to the damage dealt then gain 1 Wound. Gain 1 additional Wound for each creature that survived this damage.

name: Vigor Mortis
restriction: Castable only when an ally drops to 0 HP.
text: Castable only when an ally drops to 0 HP. Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 8. Their max actions do not change, they skip STR saves to act, and taking damage while Dying causes 1 fewer Wound (min 1).

name: Gangrenous Burst
text: Reach: Up to 8, AoE. Damage: 3d20 (ignoring armor) to damaged creatures, half on STR save (targets have disadvantage if Bloodied).

name: Unspeakable Word
text: Reach: 8. Damage: d66 with advantage (ignoring armor). On a failed INT save (disadvantage if Bloodied or Frightened) the target is Weakened 10, and you are Empowered 10 on your next attack. On save, the opposite happens instead. D66 with advantage. Roll 3d6 and drop the lowest die. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 2, 3, and 4 deals 34 damage).

source.note: "D66 with advantage." is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text. Roll dice is plain d66; the advantage (3d6 drop lowest) is in text only. The INT save decides Weakened/Empowered, not half damage.

name: Creeping Death
text: Reach: 8, AoE. Damage: 4d20. If this kills the creature, repeat the damage to another creature within Reach 8 of it not yet damaged by this effect. Repeat until a target survives or no others are within Reach.

name: Gravecraft
text: Gravemark. Magically soil a surface with blood, filth, or other disgusting things (1 Action). Gravework. Shape/move a body-sized plot of earth (1 Minute).

source.note: No casting cost in the header; each mode has its own (Gravemark 1 Action, Gravework 1 Minute), so actions and castingTime are omitted and the costs stay in text.

name: False Face
text: Change your appearance to look like someone else for 10 min. Requires a piece of them.

name: Thought Leech
text: Reach: 6. Read the surface thoughts of a creature. They can sense you doing this and may not like it.
